description: Build a single transaction that pays the mint fee from from_address AND mints the NFT to destination_address at the same time -- no separate payment step, no payment_tx. Either both happen or neither does. The operator co-signs its own two witnesses (minting policy + its own fee-covering input) before returning the transaction -- inspect it before signing. You then add your own witness for from_address and submit: sign partially_signed_tx directly (cardano-cli 'transaction sign --tx-file <this> --signing-key-file <your key>', or a CIP-30 wallet's signTx(_, true) then merge the witness) and submit it yourself -- this server cannot sign or submit on your behalf. Pin your asset to IPFS yourself first. You are solely responsible for the content referenced by ipfs_hash.
name: prepare_atomic_mint
